title: Haye muslim ke pisar
body:
haye muslim ke pisar
<<DIVIDER>>
neem jaan rote rahe apni jaan khote rahe
kuch na faryad suni us sitamgar ne magar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin dekhi na suni ye ghareebul watani
taygh haaris ki chali kat gaye dono ke sar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
behre shaah e shohada dono bache ba khuda
apne baba ki tarha ho gaye khoon may tar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun kufe may bhala jaa ke muslim se kahe
nehr par maare gaye aap ke lakhte jigar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
papliyan honton pe thi thay ghazab ke pyase
chal pade shehzade suye hauze kausar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
roke zauja ne kaha ye hai be-jurm o khata
kuch taras kha haaris in pe ye zulm na kar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono laashe ba khuda yun ba ghalgeer hui
jaise milta ho galay aake suraj se qamar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha qatl huwe mere dono bache
hoga ek hashr bapa jab sunegi maadar
haye muslim ke pisar...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi yasrab may bilal jab lahoo ki khushboo
aa gaye laal mere kehe daudi maadar
haye muslim ke pisar...
author: Bilal Kazmi
